steps.summary: I’ll trace the active config loader first, add a focused regression test for explicit-empty versus unset `APP_REGION`, then run focused tests and the full Go suite with the workspace-local build cache.

The loader now distinguishes “present with an empty string” from “not present,” so an explicit empty value overrides the file while an unset variable leaves it unchanged. I’ve added both regression cases and am validating them now.

Fixed the configuration precedence bug.

- Explicit `APP_REGION=""` now clears `config.json`’s region.
- Unset `APP_REGION` still preserves the configured region.
- Added regression tests in [loader_test.go](<<checkout>/benchmarks/config-precedence/results/study-v1/learned-2/workspace/internal/config/loader_test.go>).
- Ran focused tests and `go test ./...`; all passed.

argv: /bin/zsh -lc "sed -n '1,240p' internal/config/loader.go && printf '\\n--- tests ---\\n' && sed -n '1,280p' internal/config/loader_test.go && printf '\\n--- files ---\\n' && rg --files -g '*.go' | sort"

/bin/zsh -lc 'mkdir -p .cache/go-build && gofmt -w internal/config/loader.go internal/config/loader_test.go && GOCACHE=$PWD/.cache/go-build go test ./internal/config && GOCACHE=$PWD/.cache/go-build go test ./...'
